phases.name: Theme and core feel
phases.goal: Answer 'browser build?', write the jam design document, and prove the riskiest feel with plain shapes. Days are for a 7-day jam: scale timeboxDays to yours.

gates.text: 'Browser build?' answered before anything else: Godot 4.7 cannot export C# to the Web, so a browser jam is made in GDScript
Jam design document written (docs/GDD.md from ci/godot/templates/GDD-jam.md): the pitch and how it uses the theme, the 30-second loop with win and lose, the must-haves and a cut list
The riskiest part, usually the feel of the core action, proven with plain shapes

phases.name: Loop
phases.goal: The loop playable from start to win or lose.

gates.text: The loop is playable from the main scene, with a way to win and a way to lose
A test framework runs (hyperdot detect lists a test runner), so each must-have gets its test

phases.name: Must-haves
phases.goal: Every must-have, one at a time, each with its test; then the cut list in order. Unsure whether a feature fits? It does not.

gates.text: Every must-have works and has a test tagged GDD:F<n>; nothing from the cut list started before they all did
Every asset made by someone else is in assets.json with its source and licence, and the credits are built from it (hyperdot.ps1 credits)

phases.name: Export and submit
phases.goal: The second to last day exports to the jam's platform and launches it; the last day is fixes only, and the game goes in with time to spare.

gates.text: Exported to the jam's platform and launched (hyperdot.ps1 export -Run), and a private upload to the jam site works
The last day was fixes only: no new features
Submitted an hour or more before the deadline: the build the jam page links to is the one launched with export -Run, and the controls, the goal and the credits are on the page and in the game

phases.name: After the jam
phases.goal: Keep what the jam taught, while the players' comments are fresh.

gates.text: Retrospective written (docs/RETRO.md): what players said, what to keep for the next jam or a bigger game, what to stop
